@graph.name: AgenQ
@graph.description: AgenQ is AI training and onboarding software for insurance agencies and brokerages. Staff ask how to do a task and AgenQ shows each step on their screen inside EZLynx or AMS360. In Execution Mode, AgenQ can complete approved tasks, with a person approving the important steps.

@graph.name: Your Procedures Inside Your Software | AgenQ Product Knowledge
@graph.description: AgenQ uses your agency's procedures and training material, so employees learn the software your way. Keep know how in the business when people leave.

mainEntity.name: Does AgenQ use our procedures or generic instructions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your approved procedures, training material and guided tasks.

mainEntity.name: What happens when our process changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Update your procedures, and AgenQ follows the new steps.

mainEntity.name: Does AgenQ know things nobody wrote down?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Knowledge needs to be captured in your procedures or training material first.
